snippet.title: Policenauts (3DO) - Opening Gameplay
snippet.description: Here is the opening cinema and beginning gameplay to one of my all time favorite games, Policenauts for the 3DO. This was the first console version (it first appeared on the PC-98)and was subsequently ported to the Saturn and Playstation.
